newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says forces kill 20 Kurdish rebels in clash.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says forces kill 20 Kurdish rebels in clash.

text.p: Turkish security forces killed 20 Kurdish rebels and air force planes bombed rebel hideouts in clashes on Saturday in eastern Tunceli province, military officials in the region said.

They said some 2,000 troops, backed by mortars, tanks and assault helicopters, circled about 50 members of the separatist Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) near the town of Cemisgezek in the clash which was continuing on Saturday afternoon.
A PKK rebel was captured, officials said.
In another part of Tunceli, two air force planes bombed PKK hideouts in Kutluderesi ravine, military officials said.
More than 21,000 people have died in the PKK's 12-year-old campaign for an independent state.
